استجليا (form X)
# اِسْتَجْلَيَا (istajlayā) /is.tad͡ʒ.la.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَجْلَى (istajlā)
# اُسْتُجْلِيَا (ustujliyā) /us.tud͡ʒ.li.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَجْلَى (istajlā)
# اِسْتَجْلِيَا (istajliyā) /is.tad͡ʒ.li.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَجْلَى (istajlā)
